title: Farming Meadow
description: A farming-focused modpack that expands Minecraft with new crops, biomes, animals, and tools, turning survival into a richer and more immersive agricultural adventure.
body: Farming Meadow turns minecraft into a living, breathing landscape for those who prefer homesteading. by integrating new crops, diverse biomes, and deeper agricultural systems, this pack creates a grounded survival experience tailored for building and cultivation.
